recognize_zh: 高倍下單調一致的小到中型淋巴樣細胞，核輪廓不規則、略有切跡，染色質中等凝集、核仁不明顯，細胞質極少，其間散在粉紅色細胞質的上皮樣組織細胞（pink histiocytes），是被套細胞淋巴瘤的典型組合。
features: Monotonous small-to-medium lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm
Irregular, angulated to slightly cleaved nuclear contours
Moderately dense, evenly dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Scattered single epithelioid histiocytes with pink cytoplasm
Small hyalinized vessels; absence of large centroblasts, paraimmunoblasts, and plasma cells
describe_en: High-power view shows a diffuse, monotonous population of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm, irregular to slightly cleaved nuclear contours, moderately dense chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli. Scattered single epithelioid histiocytes with eosinophilic cytoplasm and small hyalinized vessels are present. Large transformed cells, paraimmunoblasts, and plasma cells are not conspicuous. Findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma, pending confirmation with cyclin D1 and SOX11.

ddx.vs: SLL cells have round nuclei with clumped chromatin and proliferation centers with paraimmunoblasts, and are cyclin D1 negative.
FL contains a mixture of centrocytes and centroblasts in follicles and is CD10/BCL6 positive and cyclin D1 negative.

ddx.dx: Blastoid mantle cell lymphoma or lymphoblastic lymphoma
ddx.vs: Blastoid cells have finer chromatin and high mitotic activity; lymphoblastic lymphoma is TdT positive and cyclin D1 negative.
MZL has monocytoid cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and plasmacytic differentiation and is CD5/cyclin D1 negative.
